newsitem.title: USA: Dillard revises December sales report.
newsitem.headline: Dillard revises December sales report.

text.p: Dillard Department Stores Inc said Thursday it was adjusting its December sales report by changing the year-earlier comparison period to the five weeks ended January 6, 1996, from the five weeks ended December 30, 1995.
Dillard said it was making the change in order to make its report similar to those of other retailers.
It said its same-store sales for the five week ended January 4 increased 4.4 percent compared to the five weeks ended January 6, 1996. It originally reported a decrease of 2.6 percent.
